selected_citations.field: 邊(边) entry; component roles and four OCR-highlighted occurrences [1618,1619), [1662,1663), [1750,1751), [1809,1810)
selected_citations.text: The headword is 邊(边). Comparing each highlighted location with repeated forms in the same paragraph, all four spans print 臱, not OCR 昪. The main formation clause assigns movement meaning to 辵 and sound to 臱. Later, the book says the simplified 边 replaces the elaborate 臱 form with 力. A separate proposed oracle-form account describes 自 as 鼻’s original graph and 丙 as a sound element; it is separate from the main 臱 clause. The scan establishes what this book prints, not the ancient sound relationship or whether its 臱 occurrence is historically identical to units named in other accounts.
